task: T07 — GSP policy display bounded verification
executor: main session cx/gpt-5.5; no subagent output used
constraints: R0 offline only; no GPU/SSH/MMIO/BAR/PCI operation, patch, reload, reset or firmware write

runtime_version_gap.reason: Exact GSP binary/hash for runtime version is not in the review package; no fixed address delta was assumed.

input_hashes.evidence/gsp_name_xrefs.json: bounded raw windows; hash retained in workspace

claims.target_question: GSP binary exact version/hash có đủ để phân tích không?
claims.claim: 615.78.08 GSP exact binary is present and its .fwversion and SHA-256 match the independent inventory; 615.71.09 binary is absent.
claims.hardware_firmware_scope: project GSP 615.78.08; runtime target history says 615.71.09
claims.method: sha256 plus bounded ELF inventory read
claims.alternative_explanation: 615.78.08 may be an old/local artifact, not the current loaded firmware

claims.claim: Two bounded sites form the RmDisableDisplay name and call helper 0x045e130c; worker 0x04b30030 caches value 1 at object +0x334.
claims.method: raw RISC-V instruction windows and assertion verifier
claims.alternative_explanation: static references do not prove the callers are reached in target boot
claims.limitation: helper fallback and runtime key value unresolved
claims.next_discriminator: read-only capture of effective packaged registry or exact runtime trace

claims.target_question: +0x334 có ảnh hưởng capability output không?
claims.claim: Consumer 0x04b20f54 reads +0x334; zero falls through to byte 1 and nonzero branches to a path writing byte 0, after other prerequisites.
claims.alternative_explanation: output byte semantics are local to this consumer; source-level result name unknown
claims.limitation: other prerequisites and runtime reachability unresolved
claims.next_discriminator: bounded caller/response identity or runtime capability response

claims.target_question: Host registry có đường đến GSP list không?
claims.claim: Official 615.78.08 host source and firmware dataflow connect osPackageRegistry -> packed registry -> NVKV -> GMCAPI_CMD_GSP_INIT 0x00010001 -> typed configuration list.
claims.source_hash_or_commit: host manifest commit ca2d03e6fafd4d4b56b383497d931c25b283bfcf; firmware SHA above
claims.locator: host encoder and firmware packet 0x10001 paths
claims.method: official source correlation plus bounded raw firmware verification
claims.alternative_explanation: saved source and saved binary build linkage is not cryptographically proven

claims.target_question: Selector 0x3814 có semantic TU106 exact không?
claims.claim: The two local predicates use selector 0x3814 with masks 0x000c0000 and bit 27, but exact TU106 field name/physical source is not proven.
claims.method: raw instruction decode with cross-generation names deliberately rejected
claims.alternative_explanation: selector may be an internal accessor index rather than BAR0 fuse offset
claims.limitation: no exact-tag TU106 header field found
claims.next_discriminator: exact GSP/runtime trace plus TU106-specific field definition

claims.target_question: GSP path có đủ để kết luận khôi phục display không?
claims.claim: No. Static GSP policy path is one layer; it does not prove effective value, host fuse bypass, display engine/PHY presence, VBIOS routing, or DP/DVI signal.
claims.limitation: R0 excludes runtime intervention and target trace
claims.next_discriminator: safe read-only target capture under separately approved scope
